links.outcome: Calibration drift on temporal validation cohort despite stable discrimination
links.effect: Calibration intercepts shifted downward from internal holdout to temporal cohort (XGBoost Δintercept -0.866; LightGBM -0.977), indicating overprediction, while AUC was largely preserved (XGBoost 0.881).
links.quote: Calibration drift occurred despite stable AUC and was partly correctable by recalibration, underscoring the need for calibration monitoring before clinical deployment.

links.outcome: Effect of logistic recalibration on temporal-cohort calibration and Brier score
links.effect: Apparent logistic recalibration set intercept to approximately 0 and slope to 1.0 in the temporal cohort and improved XGBoost Brier score from 0.111 to 0.100.
links.quote: Apparent logistic recalibration set the intercept to approximately 0 and the slope to 1.0 in the temporal cohort and improved the XGBoost Brier score from 0.111 to 0.100.
